title: Lack of access control in `CLGauge` creation allows unauthorized `Pools`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `CLGaugeFactory.createGauge` function can be called by anyone, which creates a front-running vulnerability. An attacker can monitor the mempool for legitimate `Voter.createCLGauge` transactions and front-run them, calling `CLGaugeFactory.createGauge` with the same pool address before the transaction from Voter contract is processed.  ```solidity     function createGauge(         address _pool,         address _internal_bribe,         address _kitten,         bool _isPool     ) external returns (address) {         CLGaug
